Subject: Recap & recommended pilot path — Redwood Dedicated (VPC)

Hi Ezra,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — I wanted to capture the quick recap and recommended path so we’re aligned. Great to hear Orbit’s goals: serving PII-enabled insights from production data, sub-150ms 95th percentile latency for interactive queries, and an initial target of ~10k QPS/day (burst to 25k).

Recap of what we discussed
- Workload: user-facing inference on customer PII (redaction + tokenization in your pipeline)
- Constraint: data must remain in your VPC / no logging to vendor-managed storage
- Performance target: 95p < 150ms; steady traffic ~10k/day
- Timeline: preference for a Q2 pilot, potential GA in Q3 depending on procurement

Recommended next steps (proposed)
1) Quick security handoff: we’ll send SOC2 summary and data-retention/ingress controls (attached).
2) Pilot: 12-week Dedicated pilot in your VPC (Redwood Private control plane w/ customer-managed networking) — we’ll size a 2-GPU reserved pool to start, with autoscale headroom for bursts.
3) Ops/POC kickoff: propose April 4–8 window for an onboarding call to scope network, IAM, and test data.
4) Procurement: I'll share a short SOW + cost sheet; if procurement can review in early March we can lock the April slot.

Attachments: pilot-outline.pdf (brief), soc2-summary.pdf

Open questions I have for you
- Who will own the procurement conversation on your side (name + email)?
- Is the pilot expected to use masked/hashed PII or raw data in the VPC?
- Do you have a preferred start week in April?

If you’re comfortable with that approach I’ll circulate the SOW and a cost worksheet for the 12-week pilot.

Thanks,
